task.question: Which country wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup on July 19, 2026?
task.evidence: 19 July – Spain wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup after defeating Argentina 1–0 at the final.

answer:
Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup on July 19, 2026, defeating Argentina 1-0 in the final held at MetLife Stadium. Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in extra time after Argentina's Enzo Fernández received a red card, reducing his team to 10 men. This victory marked Spain's second World Cup title, having previously won in 2010.

FINAL: Spain

Played from June 28 to July 19, 2026, the knockout stage ended with the final, held at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The top two teams from each of the twelve groups, along with the best eight third-place teams, advanced to the knockout stage to compete in a single-elimination tournament. The tournament began on June 11, 2026, and concluded on July 19 with Spain winning the championship for the second time.
